One of my favorite go-to recipes is a tasty soup with rice (or quinoa), barley, split peas, lentils, and some basic dried seasonings.

Math time.

  • A single batch of soup takes 1/4 cup of each ingredient and yields 5-6 full bowl servings.
  • A 16 oz bag of each ingredient runs ~$1 per and will yield 8 batches, or 40-48 servings.
  • I'll be generous and say that dried seasonings run $3 each. So $4 for the 16oz bags of ingredients, plus $12 for seasonings.
  • $16 for 40-48 servings (I'll say 44 to average it out) = $.36 per serving.
